comment: config(0, 0, 0, 0): no parameters, inputs, outputs or lights. The die is a CallbackButton added with addChild (src/alea.cpp:84), so it has no census position and cannot be reached by a help click. The list of models is gathered once in the constructor by walking rack::plugin::plugins, and the chosen module is added through APP->engine->addModule with a history entry pushed so it can be undone (src/alea.cpp:7-21). The panel prints only the module name and the die face.
